lines: He texted a photo from the stage door the second he got it — you'll just have to imagine it, but trust me, it's a whole look.
Thank you, truly.
Still asking around? Try the gas station — half the county passes through there before nine.
Any luck yet? I really do appreciate this.
The bag's got everything — tights, the headpiece, all of it. Whoever you find, they can't miss it.
My kid's in a dance showcase in the city tonight, and half his costume's still sitting right here on the table.
I've got the firehouse tonight, or I'd drive it down myself. If you hear of anybody headed that way today, would you ask them for me?
Tell me that bag made it to the stage door in one piece.
Any luck down at Cellar Door? Renata usually knows who's headed where.
Nobody from in here's going down today, far as I know.
Check the board at Tops on your way through — and Cellar Door in Hobart, Renata always seems to know who's coming and going.
Morning! Coffee's on, and the sundae bar's real, if you're curious.
Glad it worked out. Come by for a tasting sometime, once things settle down.
Go on, catch him before he leaves — the gas station, up in Jefferson.
Not me today — my truck's in the shop.
But I saw someone loading a cooler bag into their trunk up at the gas station this morning. That's a city grocery run, and it didn't come from Tops.
That'll be Walt. Ask at J&H.
Welcome — pull up a seat on the bench anytime.
Tell the kid I said break a leg, wherever he heard that from.
Priya's kid's costume? Sure, I'm headed down myself today — every other Friday, like clockwork.
Hand it here, I'll have it at the stage door by six.

effects.toast: Episode complete — new story next week

lines: Every other Friday I'm elbow-deep in city traffic by nine. Don't ask me why I keep doing it to myself.
Taped by the register: "Anybody headed down today? Ask around!" Half the county's already heard.
